thesis: Mishra’s Factory solved a control deck’s oldest tension by being both a land and a threat, then added combat depth through the ability of Assembly-Workers to reinforce one another.

playbook.role: Develop mana first and animate only when the attack, block, or pump changes the exchange. Multiple Factories reward careful ordering because an unanimated copy can strengthen the one already in combat.
